name: Starter_v6mod (jpkfox)
summary: This EA is a multi-indicator momentum-based trading system that uses EMA Angle, Laguerre RSI with Laguerre filter, CCI, and two EMAs to generate buy/sell signals. It incorporates grid-style position stepping, trailing stops, daily loss limits, Friday exit rules, and a lot-decrease factor after consecutive losses. Positions are managed with both indicator-based and time-based exit conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个基于多指标动量的交易系统，使用EMA角度、Laguerre RSI加Laguerre过滤器、CCI和两条EMA生成买卖信号。它融合了网格式仓位步进、追踪止损、每日亏损限制、周五平仓规则以及连续亏损后减仓机制，并通过指标和时间双重条件管理仓位出场。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多指标动量确认：EMA角度指标判断趋势方向（正值看空，负值看多），Laguerre RSI判断超买超卖区域，CCI确认动量方向，双EMA（120和40周期）提供趋势跟踪确认。买入条件为Laguerre RSI低于0.15（超卖）、双EMA均下行且CCI小于0，表明下跌动量中寻找反弹机会；卖出条件相反。出场方面，持仓买单在Laguerre RSI超过0.85时平仓，持仓卖单在低于0.15时平仓，周五20点后强制平仓所有仓位。仓位管理采用网格步进逻辑，新买单需距最低持仓价格一定距离（ExtStepGrid），避免过度集中入场。资金管理支持固定手数或风险百分比模式，亏损后按DecreaseFactor缩减持仓量，每日最大亏损次数限制为3次，且保证金低于阈值时停止交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept relies on multi-indicator momentum confirmation: the EMA Angle indicator determines trend direction (negative values signal uptrend, positive values signal downtrend), the Laguerre RSI identifies overbought/oversold zones, CCI confirms momentum direction, and dual EMAs (period 120 and 40) provide trend-following confirmation. The buy condition requires Laguerre RSI below 0.15 (oversold), both EMAs declining, and CCI below zero, seeking reversal opportunities within bearish momentum; the sell condition is the mirror opposite. For exits, long positions close when Laguerre RSI exceeds 0.85, short positions close when it drops below 0.15, and all positions are forcefully closed after Friday 20:00. Position management uses a grid-stepping logic where new buy entries must be a minimum distance (ExtStepGrid) from the lowest existing buy price, preventing over-concentration. Money management supports either fixed lot sizing or risk-percentage mode, with lot size reduced by a DecreaseFactor after losses, a daily maximum of 3 losing trades, and trading halted when equity falls below the margin cutoff threshold.

pros: 多指标组合确认，减少假信号：EMA角度判趋势方向，Laguerre RSI判超买超卖，CCI和双EMA双重确认动量
完善的风险控制体系：每日亏损次数限制、保证金阈值停止交易、连续亏损减仓机制、最大持仓数限制
周五强制平仓避免周末跳空风险，网格步进防止仓位过度集中入场
支持固定手数和风险百分比两种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同账户规模
pros_en: Multi-indicator confirmation reduces false signals: EMA Angle for trend direction, Laguerre RSI for overbought/oversold, CCI and dual EMAs for momentum confirmation
Comprehensive risk control system: daily loss count limit, margin cutoff threshold, lot decrease after consecutive losses, maximum position count limit
Friday forced exit avoids weekend gap risk, and grid stepping prevents over-concentration of entry positions
Supports both fixed lot and risk-percentage money management modes, flexibly adapting to different account sizes
cons: 入场逻辑存在矛盾：买入条件要求双EMA均下行且CCI小于0，这是在下跌趋势中做多，本质是逆势交易而非动量跟随，逻辑不够一致
追踪止损逻辑在CheckOpenPositions和独立Trailing函数中重复实现，Trailing函数从未被调用，属于死代码
缺少新K线检测机制，每个tick都可能触发交易逻辑，在高频行情中可能导致重复开仓或过度交易
止损35点而止盈仅10点，盈亏比仅约0.29，需要极高的胜率才能盈利，长期可持续性存疑
cons_en: Contradictory entry logic: buy conditions require both EMAs declining and CCI below zero, which means buying in a downtrend — this is counter-trend rather than momentum following, creating logical inconsistency
Trailing stop logic is duplicated in CheckOpenPositions and a standalone Trailing() function that is never called, representing dead code
Lacks new bar detection mechanism, meaning trading logic can trigger on every tick, potentially causing redundant entries or over-trading during volatile conditions
Stop loss of 35 pips vs take profit of 10 pips yields a risk-reward ratio of only ~0.29, requiring an extremely high win rate for profitability, raising sustainability concerns
improvements: 添加新K线检测机制（isNewBar），避免每个tick重复执行交易逻辑，减少不必要的计算和潜在重复开仓
修正入场逻辑的一致性：如果策略定位为动量跟随，买入应在EMA上行的上升趋势中进行；如果定位为均值回归，则应明确标注策略类型并增加反转确认指标
调用或移除未使用的Trailing()函数，消除死代码，并统一追踪止损的实现位置
增加点差过滤机制，避免在高点差时段（如新闻发布前后、流动性低的时段）开仓，提升剥头皮类交易的胜率
improvements_en: Add new bar detection (isNewBar) to prevent trading logic from executing on every tick, reducing unnecessary computation and potential redundant entries

Fix entry logic consistency: if the strategy is momentum-following, buys should occur during uptrends with rising EMAs; if it's mean reversion, clearly label the strategy type and add reversal confirmation indicators
Invoke or remove the unused Trailing() function to eliminate dead code and consolidate trailing stop implementation in one location
Add spread filtering to avoid opening positions during high-spread periods (e.g., around news releases or low-liquidity sessions), improving win rates for scalping-style trades

risk_points: 止损远大于止盈（35 vs 10 pips），盈亏比极低，连续亏损时资金回撤风险大
无新K线检测，可能在同一根K线内多次开仓，尤其在快速行情中增加风险敞口
网格步进逻辑允许同方向最多开10个仓位，在极端行情中累计风险敞口可能很大
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下开仓可能直接导致亏损
risk_points_en: Stop loss far exceeds take profit (35 vs 10 pips), yielding an extremely low risk-reward ratio that amplifies drawdown risk during losing streaks
No new bar detection may allow multiple entries within the same bar, increasing risk exposure especially during rapid market moves
Grid stepping logic allows up to 10 same-direction positions, potentially creating large cumulative risk exposure in extreme market conditions
Lack of spread filtering may result in immediate losses when opening positions during high-spread environments
